title: Read an array item
summary: Swift: Read an array item. Read pets[0].
introduction: An array keeps values of one type in order. Position zero is first.
learningObjectives: Read an array item with Swift

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.
The zero-based array has dog at position 1.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An index outside the array stops the program.
